name: bulc-building-designer
description: Drive the BULC fire, evacuation, HVAC and sprinkler simulator from Claude — with an ontology, rules and playbooks that keep the model from making modelling mistakes.
long_description:
Connects Claude to the BULC desktop app running on this PC (127.0.0.1 bridge, found automatically through the app's discovery file) and exposes the app's full tool set: opening and saving projects, architectural floor-plan recognition (walls, doors, windows) and building import, geometry, Shape Studio, meshing, run settings, pre-flight checks, runs and progress, fire result summaries and ASET, outputs, fires, materials, detectors and controls, sprinkler and water-spray networks with hydraulics, pump sizing and design review, HVAC ducts, evacuation runs and results, the result viewer and screenshots.

It also ships a knowledge pack — a domain ontology, 166 rules (condition → check → fix), 38 common LLM mistakes, six playbooks, a Korean–English–FDS glossary and an FDS 6.10.1 key reference — as resources, prompts and tools, plus local checks that work without the app: plan review (bulc_plan_check), drawing intake for DWG/DXF/PDF/ZIP/IFC files (bulc_drawing_intake), deterministic FDS deck lint (bulc_check_deck) and mesh advice (bulc_mesh_advisor).

Requires the BULC desktop application (licensed, 0.89 or later recommended) to be installed and running. Drawings are read locally; nothing is uploaded by this extension.

bridge_port.title: BULC bridge port (fallback)
bridge_port.description: Only needed for BULC versions that do not write the bridge discovery file: the port of the bridge the app opens on 127.0.0.1 (the app's BULC_BRIDGE_PORT, default 8787). Newer BULC versions are found automatically.

bridge_token.title: BULC bridge token (optional)
bridge_token.description: Only if BULC runs with BULC_BRIDGE_AUTH and this extension cannot read the app's discovery file (BULC/bridge.json): the token from that file.
